context: Sprint 14 notes. Dan leads the team. Team: Noa (frontend), Ben (backend), Rita (QA). Release is planned for Thursday. Open bugs at the start of the week: 9. Latest design file: v7. API p95 latency target: 500 ms. Dan owns the contact with the payment provider; the API key request is pending since Monday. Dan has 2 pull request reviews waiting.

lines.text: Good morning everyone. Let us do a quick round. Noa, you start.

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Morning. Yesterday I worked on the login screen, and today I will finish the error states. I will have the login screen done by tomorrow.
Great. Anything blocking you?

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: I am not sure which design file is the latest. I have v5 open.
It is the newest one, I will post the link in the channel.

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Thanks. Dan, can you review my pull request today?
Yes, I will review it after planning.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: My turn. I finished the orders endpoint, but I am blocked on the API key from the payment provider.
I own that contact, I will chase it today.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Also, the load test shows a p95 latency of 800 ms on the orders endpoint.
That is above our target. Is it the database or the code?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Probably a slow query. And honestly we cannot ship Thursday without a full load test.
What does the load test need from us, and how long does it run?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Also the release will have to move to Friday, I think.
Let us decide that after we hear Rita.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Hi. I have twelve open bugs now and three are blockers.
Which three are blockers?

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Checkout rounding, the login redirect, and a flaky test in the nightly run.
Okay. Please put the three in the channel with owners.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Sure. Also, for the demo on Wednesday, who prepares the slides?
I will take the demo slides.

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Can we also fix the date format on the invoice page? It shows the month first for our European users.
Good point, let us add it to the backlog.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Sure. Who is on call this weekend? Nobody wrote it down.
Let me sort that out in a moment. First, Ben and Noa, anything else?

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Ben, did you merge the branch for the cart?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Not yet, I will do it after standup.

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Who wants coffee after this? I am going downstairs.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Yes please, a double.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: I brought my own today.
Lunch is on me on Friday if we ship.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: Dan, can you send me the test plan link?
Sure, I will post it with the design link.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: By the way, I am planning two weeks of vacation in August, can we talk about it?
Let us talk about vacation after standup so we finish the sprint round.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: One more thing. I will send the updated API doc today.
And I will send the updated sprint plan today.

lines.speaker: Noa
lines.text: Wait, we did not decide about the on call.
Right. Ben takes Saturday, Noa takes Sunday, and I am the backup.

lines.speaker: Rita
lines.text: And the release day? Thursday or Friday?
We decide after the load test result.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Fine with me.
Thanks all. Talk tomorrow.
